name: Láegaire
text: Láegaire is a variant spelling of Lóegaire. MacKillop 2008 also lists Laoghaire and Laeghire among the forms of that name. Readers should follow the cross-reference to Lóegaire, which receives the main treatment.

attributes.attribute: variant spelling, with Laoghaire and Laeghire, of the name Lóegaire
given no independent article by MacKillop 2008

okr.objective: Cross-references the spelling Láegaire and its variants to the main entry, Lóegaire.
key_results: Laoghaire and Laeghire are recorded as further spellings of the same name
Lóegaire itself has no node yet and awaits a later batch
